beats.req_after_done: This run is closed: requirements need a new run (another --run-id).
beats.req_cycle_dep: adding `{{dep}}` as a dependency of `{{id}}` would create a dependency cycle.
beats.req_full: requirement count reached the cap {{cap}} — close some before adding more.
beats.req_panel_counts: 需求 {{total}}：立项 {{draft}} / 计划中 {{planning}} / 门禁 {{gate}} / 待开发 {{ready}} / 开发中 {{developing}} / 复核 {{review}} / 集成 {{integrating}} / 完成 {{done}}
beats.req_lane_panel: [job slots] {{lanes}} (global cap {{cap}}, {{jobs}} running) — analyze / plan / develop all run asynchronously; the requirement graph and gate checks are serial
beats.req_dispatch_usage: requirement.dispatch [""|0|rN] — empty/0 dispatches by readiness order, rN dispatches only that requirement
beats.req_wait_rejected: [BLOCKED:TODO] `{{action}}` is not available yet: {{detail}} Primary state unchanged.
beats.req_list_props: {{count}} pending proposals (the main agent accepts serially, canonical order):
beats.req_list_legend: 图例：·立项 ◇计划中 ⊟计划门禁 ○待开发 ▶开发中 ◀交付受理 ⊞验收门禁 ◉集成 ✓完成 ⑂拆分 ⇄合并 ⊘废弃 ⚠受阻
beats.req_trace_stale: (stale: the proposal rev is outdated, rebase and resubmit)
beats.req_why_conflict: {{id}} has an unresolved conflict awaiting a human decision
beats.req_dispatch_noop_none: [DISPATCH] 0 candidates (requirements are in a job, in a gate, awaiting acceptance, or done) | jobs {{jobs}}/{{cap}}
beats.req_dispatch_noop_blocked: [DISPATCH] 0 candidates: jobs {{jobs}}/{{cap}} is full, or development candidates are not ready / lanes are taken ({{lanes}}). Reasons: {{reasons}}
beats.req_prop_stage_mismatch: {{id}} is currently {{status}}; it cannot accept a {{stage}} proposal (stage and state do not match).
beats.req_prop_plan_missing: {{id}} is currently {{status}} but has no approved plan (the plan gate has not passed, or was invalidated by amend / gate reject): pass gate.approve(plan) before submitting a development proposal.
beats.req_prop_none: no pending proposal (proposal.submit first, or pick another req/proposal id).
beats.req_accept_stale: proposal {{id}} is bound to rev {{got}} while requirement {{req}} is already rev {{want}} — judged stale; rebase and resubmit (an old proposal must not override a newer decision).
beats.req_gate_none: no gate is awaiting approval (plan_gate / accept).
beats.req_gate_no_evidence: the accept_gate for {{id}} has no artifact evidence (artifacts is empty) — a summary-only claim is not accepted; have the executor submit a diff / test output first.
beats.req_gate_stale: the gate for {{id}} is bound to rev {{got}} while the current rev is {{want}} — stale, approval is not allowed (redo the proposal on the new rev first).
beats.req_gate_verify: with require_all_green on you must run verify.submit all_green=true first.
beats.req_gate_props: {{pending}} proposals are still pending — accept them serially first.
beats.req_gate_jobs: {{jobs}} jobs are still running (cap {{cap}}) — collect their proposals first.
beats.req_gate_conflicts: {{conflicts}} unresolved conflicts — have the user decide the resolution path first.
beats.req_gate_open: {{open}} requirements are not done yet — walk them through both gates first.
beats.req_split_usage: requirement.split "parent_id|child title A|child title B[|…]" (at least two children)
beats.req_split_status: {{id}} is currently {{status}} — a split requires draft / analyzing / planning, no pending proposal, no gate and no lane.
beats.req_split_blocked: {{id}} has an unresolved conflict — run requirement.resolve first.
beats.req_split_ok: [REQ SPLIT] {{id}} → {{ids}} (inherited deps {{deps}}; the parent becomes terminal split for traceability)
beats.req_merge_status: {{id}} is currently {{status}} — a merge requires draft / analyzing / planning, no pending proposal, no gate and no lane.
beats.req_merge_ok: [REQ MERGED] {{ids}} → new requirement {{id}} "{{title}}" (deps unioned: {{deps}}; sources become terminal merged)
beats.req_amend_usage: requirement.amend "req_id|new title|new description|new deps" (empty segment = unchanged; deps `-` = clear)
beats.req_amend_closed: {{id}} is {{status}} — amend its successor requirement instead.
beats.req_amend_deps_active: {{id}} is developing — the title/description may change, the deps may not.
beats.req_amend_hist_active: v{{rev}} work description amended (developing, progress kept)
beats.req_amend_active: [REQ AMENDED] {{id}} is developing: title/description updated → rev {{rev}} (progress kept)
beats.req_amend_derived: [REQ DERIVED] {{id}} is done — the amend derives a new requirement {{new}} "{{title}}" (origin={{id}}, rev {{rev}})
beats.req_conflict_dup: the two sides of a conflict must be different requirements.
beats.req_conflict_status: {{id}} is {{status}} — terminal requirements cannot declare a conflict.
beats.req_conflict_busy: {{id}} is developing — wait for its delivery (or abort) before declaring a conflict.
beats.req_conflict_exists: {{id}} already has an unresolved conflict (peer {{peer}}) — run requirement.resolve first.
beats.req_conflict_ok: [REQ CONFLICT · human gate] {{first}} ⇄ {{second}}: {{note}} | both become blocked; dispatch and settlement skip them; resolution paths: {{modes}} (goal stops and waits for your choice)
beats.req_resolve_drop_busy: keep_first would abandon {{id}}, but it is {{status}} — only draft / ready can be abandoned.
beats.req_resolve_revise_busy: revise requires {{id}} to be draft / ready, currently {{status}}.
beats.req_resolve_revised: both sides kept but flagged needs-amend (amend before dispatch)
beats.req_replayed_op: [REPLAY:ASYNC] external_id `{{ext}}` was already applied — idempotent return, not executed twice.
beats.req_prop_busy: {{id}} already has a pending proposal ({{prop}}) — accept / reject it before resubmitting (no overwrite)
beats.req_prop_exec_misplaced: `exec=` must be the last segment; write `req|rev|stage|summary|artifacts||<ext>|exec=<agent_id>[:<reason>]` (the empty segment cannot be omitted).
beats.req_prop_actor_mismatch: [ACTOR MISMATCH] {{id}}: exec={{exec}} != host actor {{actor}} — recorded, not rejected (the human gate decides).
beats.req_prop_actor_misplaced: `actor=` must sit after `exec=` and before `actor_session=` in the trailing chain (fixed relative order); the host injects this segment — carry identity via `--actor` / `YGG_ACTOR` / the daemon request field instead.
beats.req_prop_actor_session_misplaced: `actor_session=` must be the last segment (after `actor=`); the host injects this segment — carry identity via `--actor-session` / `YGG_ACTOR_SESSION` / the daemon request field instead.
beats.req_prop_actor_unverified: [ACTOR UNVERIFIED] {{id}}: exec={{exec}} arrived without a host actor stamp (old host / direct dispatch).
beats.req_prop_actor_verified: [ACTOR VERIFIED] {{id}}: exec={{exec}} matches the host actor stamp (same handle namespace).
beats.req_prop_plan_gate: [PLAN GATE UP] {{id}} rev {{rev}} 的 plan 提案已交付即门禁——gate.approve / gate.reject 裁决
beats.req_accept_plan: {{id}}（{{req}} 的 plan 提案）的裁决走 gate.approve / gate.reject（交付即门禁）；proposal.accept 只受理 development 提案
beats.integration_confirmed: [INTEGRATION CONFIRMED] {{id}} develop@{{sha}} 已核验 → 完成（已终态 {{done}} 条）
beats.integration_rejected: [INTEGRATION REJECTED] {{id}} 集成打回 → 待开发；理由：{{reason}}
beats.integration_not_integrating: {{id}} 不在集成幕（当前 {{status}}）：integration.* 只对集成幕的需求生效
beats.integration_bad_sha: {{id}} 集成证据非法（期望 develop@<sha>，sha 为 7-40 位十六进制；实得 {{got}}）
